headline: Cruz won TX Senate by 8.5pt (53%-44.6%), solid win but not a landslide. 23,000 number wildly off (actual margin ~960K votes)
sources: Wikipedia: 2024 US Senate election in Texas
notes: Made Nov 1 2024 before Nov 5 election. Cruz won, but margin was 8.5 points, not a 'landslide' by conventional definition (usually 15+pt). Specific '23,000 extra votes' number bears no relation to actual margin.

headline: Multiple impeachment resolutions filed (H.Res.1155 Apr 2026, H.Res.1486 Aug 2026), none advanced. Impeachment talk dominated 2026 discourse
notes: Vision: 'impeach impeach impeach by Schumer.' Impeachment resolutions were indeed filed and pushed by Democrats. House rejected them. 128 Democrats voted with Republicans to block. Trump himself warned about it. The talk happened; the actual impeachment did not.

headline: No vote held. 85% of Greenlanders oppose joining US. PM rejected idea Jan 2026. No referendum mechanism exists
sources: Fact Check: Greenland did not vote to join US
Semafor: Greenland PM rejects joining US
notes: Vision: divided vote with young people wanting to join. Reality: no vote, overwhelming opposition, PM flat-out rejected it. Denmark discussed independence referendum but not for joining US.

headline: Ex-chief of staff Dana Williamson indicted Nov 2025 on corruption charges, guilty plea May 2026. Newsom and wife under federal investigation Jun 2026. Fined $31,500 for late reporting
sources: Bloomberg Government: Newsom ex-chief of staff indicted
GVWire: Newsom says Trump directed probe
notes: First stated Jun 8 2025: 'I'm about to deal with Gavin. Dark things will be uncovered.' Repeated Aug 31 2025: 'corruption in California, embarrassing moments coming.' Five months later ex-CoS indicted. Federal investigation opened. Strong hit.

headline: Pelosi announced she would not seek reelection, ending nearly 40-year career. Announcement came late 2025
notes: Mar 14 2025: 'Nancy Pelosi is going to retire.' She did announce retirement late 2025, ending her congressional career effective Jan 2027. Direct hit.

headline: Schumer has not retired or announced retirement. Said 'I'm staying put' in Mar 2025. Faced pressure but remained as Senate leader
sources: Daily Beast: Schumer says staying put
Axios: Schumer faces calls to step down
notes: Mar 14 2025: 'Chuck Schumer is going to retire.' He has not. His term runs to Jan 2029. He faced pressure to step aside as leader but refused.

headline: Prediction targets 2028. No scandal matching this description has occurred as of Oct 2026
